audit_scope: v0.3.20 Forward Infrastructure Incident Forensic Audit

incident_overview.summary: Forward collection infrastructure suffered dual independent failure modes: a ~5.5 hour host freeze during Windows Modern Standby power suspend causing consecutive missed slots, and local egress routing through a US proxy node causing Binance HTTP 451 geo-restriction blocks. Secondary software crashes in clock alignment and microstructure heartbeat threads were identified and resolved.

RC1_WINDOWS_MODERN_STANDBY.evidence_source: Windows System Event Log (Provider: Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power, EventIDs 506, 507)
RC1_WINDOWS_MODERN_STANDBY.mechanism: Modern Standby suspended all WSL CPU execution. Systemd timers could not fire during the suspend interval. Upon resume, systemd missed wall-clock trigger deadlines.

RC2_BINANCE_HTTP_451_REGION_RESTRICTION.error_received: HTTP Error 451: Unavailable For Legal Reasons (Service unavailable from a restricted location)
RC2_BINANCE_HTTP_451_REGION_RESTRICTION.impact: All Binance Futures REST endpoints and WebSocket handshakes were rejected due to Binance US compliance geo-fencing.

RC3_BINANCE_CLOCK_ALIGNMENT_PROCESS_CRAS.faulting_code: observed_at = max(local_observed_at, *(value for value in source_times.values() if value is not None))
RC3_BINANCE_CLOCK_ALIGNMENT_PROCESS_CRAS.mechanism: When all endpoints fail (HTTP 451), source_times has 0 valid timestamps. Unpacking an empty generator yielded a single argument to max(), causing Python to treat the integer timestamp as an iterable.

RC4_MICROSTRUCTURE_HEARTBEAT_THREAD_DEAT.mechanism: Concurrent read/write queries during status checks or disk I/O locked SQLite for >5s, causing unhandled OperationalError inside the heartbeat thread. The daemon stayed running but heartbeats ceased, yielding a ~31,715s stale heartbeat age.
RC4_MICROSTRUCTURE_HEARTBEAT_THREAD_DEAT.resolution: Added try/except protection in heartbeat_worker and implemented an async supervisor loop to resurrect the heartbeat thread if terminated.

RC5_MICROSTRUCTURE_STATUS_QUERY_BOTTLENE.mechanism: MicrostructureStore.status() executed PRAGMA integrity_check and read millions of trade rows from disk across 5.0 GB of SQLite partition files on every 15-minute health check, thrashing CPU for 65+ seconds.
RC5_MICROSTRUCTURE_STATUS_QUERY_BOTTLENE.resolution: Implemented mtime/size-keyed persistent partition cache and pre-merged interval evaluation, reducing query duration from 65.0s to 2.6s (25x speedup).

RC6_WSL_USER_LINGER_DISABLED.mechanism: Without linger enabled, closing WSL interactive terminal sessions terminates the user systemd instance and all child timers.
RC6_WSL_USER_LINGER_DISABLED.resolution: Automated loginctl enable-linger in installer and recovery scripts.
